title: Storm Reveal
summary: A pocket-size three-piece sleepy cloud puzzle whose single guided twist turns a disguised curl and zig into a standing rainbow-and-lightning storm scene.
interaction: Rotate the outer rainbow 90 degrees clockwise to reveal; reverse to reset.
limitations: Digital geometry checks do not prove successful printing, friction feel, wear life, drop retention, or human response.
The removable square connection avoids a brittle snap and may require printer-specific fit tuning after a physical coupon.
